annotation_policy.decision_context: Exact matched sentence and wider quote; current-method clause may cite a prior procedure only with explicit current action and no remaining historical cue; optional evidence.procedure_reference records the exception; level1 abstract demonstrative result may use the immediately preceding current claim only with repeated subject noun; exact evidence.antecedent text/start/end validated; no historical, hypothetical or comparison-clause borrowing; causal result connector and causal action before the hit may link at most two preceding abstract sentences, each adjacent pair sharing content words, ending at an explicit current-work anchor; exact evidence.causal_chain sentences/offsets/shared_terms/hit_start validated; history/hypothesis/comparison/paragraph break rejected
annotation_policy.taxonomy: oled-directions-v19:53 stable semantic concepts; existing definitions/parents unchanged, new concepts defined in round report
annotation_policy.workflow_evidence: All required workflow use and product-context quotes retained; body evidence required before metadata purpose can establish core status
annotation_policy.core_context: Optional taxonomy core_context_patterns express composite workflow purpose only, never supply missing fulltext use evidence
annotation_policy.mechanism_core_context: Speculative side explanations and general alternatives cannot borrow a neighboring outcome contribution verb; exact accepted evidence retained as supporting. Explicit title/abstract study targets or separate direct evidence can remain core. Source admission, level1, other dimensions and vocabulary unchanged.
annotation_policy.method_negation: Level2 method use denial is clause-scoped: active/passive denial and coordinated noun lists; contrast/new subject/action reset; not-only additive. Exact denied evidence remains mentioned, not used. Vocabulary and core selection unchanged; lexical1.4.5 stays isolated.
annotation_policy.method_causal_core: Accepted method as grammatical subject explicitly links scientific outcome to physical process in results/discussion/conclusion; positive nonhistorical nonhypothetical sentence only. No neighboring subject borrowing; evidence unchanged. Source admission, vocabulary and existing core routes unchanged.
annotation_policy.method_use_forms: Complete bounded operation forms and retained measurement/calculation nouns replace broad stems (performance/conductivity are not use evidence). Existing positive method-subject causal-result predicate can supply nominal use. History/negation/source and core selection routes retained; exact evidence preserved.
annotation_policy.citation_continuation: One immediately preceding same-chunk cited-author sentence (et al./reported by) owns an adjacent passive scientific action unless explicit we/our/current-work language resets. No paragraph/chunk/source/multiple-sentence propagation; title review scope retained. Rejected hit remains mentioned with exact citation_antecedent text/start/end; validator checks mention quotes and trace. Prior-procedure exception cannot erase external ownership.
annotation_policy.title_comparison: Level1 topic hit directly governed by beyond with optional conventional/traditional/standard/established qualifier supplies comparison-only mention, not affirmative title evidence. Another title hit or independent abstract evidence can still establish the label; no label-wide veto or body/abstract change. Exact title_comparison text/start/end/hit_start/hit_end validated. Rejected title evidence is retained in mentions even when same label has independent accepted evidence.
annotation_policy.abstract_develop_forms: Only metadata abstract ownership and abstract result antecedent use complete develop/develops/developed/developing words. Nominal development/developments and accidental suffixes alone cannot establish focus; explicit current owner and actual actions retained. Shared fulltext FOCUS and body policy remain as1.4.12. Initial global1.4.13 regressed L2 and is retained, never promoted. Rejected records preserved in immutable old outputs/private audit; existing mentions limits unchanged.
annotation_policy.bibliography_ownership: Line-initial numbered entries require at least two sequential surname/initial authors; local entry ends at next marker/blank paragraph, never another chunk. Override incorrect body section ownership for L2 and degradation workflow context. Exact bibliography_entry text/start/end/author_count retained as mentioned and validated, including when independent use exists. Does not detect all unnumbered/truncated references or parse mixed paragraphs.
annotation_policy.rolloff_forms: Existing efficiency/EQE-qualified rolloff compounds retain singular/plural aliases and now accept multiple qualifier-to-compound whitespace. Exact original offsets retained. Accepted1.4.20 generic-background core guard, source/negation/keyword/metadata guards and thresholds unchanged. Historical1.4.18 retained separately; no bare rolloff or attenuation alias; no1.4.17 bibliography-fragment merge.
annotation_policy.question_background_core: Only question dimension: explicit local generic/literature qualifier before a hit cannot add core contribution or main-chunk votes without same-clause current owner. Punctuation/contrast resets scope, including periods before numbered citations. Accepted quotes remain supporting; explicit metadata study targets and independent current-result routes retained. No source admission, vocabulary or quantity threshold change.
annotation_policy.abstract_passive_current: Only L1 abstract hits lacking old own-focus: subject precedes is/are/was/were for the first time studied/fabricated/examined/characterized/synthesized within120chars in same clause; no intervening second finite predication. Explicit prior/citation/negation/hypothesis/future context blocks new route. Existing focus/antecedent/causal/fulltext/taxonomy/core thresholds unchanged; exact original evidence preserved.
annotation_policy.circular_polarization_topic: L1 topic: material emits circularly polarized luminescence; Chinese name/English full name and controlled aliases/definition recorded. US/UK spellings/hyphen whitespace accepted. CPL alone, circular dichroism or only circular excitation light do not match. Existing metadata ownership/negation/comparison/history/source/core rules unchanged; L2 spectroscopy/chiral-response references are distinct concepts.
annotation_policy.molecular_inverse_design_topic: L1 topic: learned model maps target properties to inverse molecular design; explicit machine/deep learning or neural network, molecular object and inverse design, any order within bounded punctuation-local phrase. Prediction/screening alone, nonmolecular devices, AI-only future integration and denied purpose excluded. Existing ownership/source/core rules unchanged; L2 method is separate.
annotation_policy.nominal_degradation_result_use: Existing joint chromatography-MS degradation-product method accepts a bounded LC/GC-MS subject explicitly revealing/identifying/detecting/showing degradation products in current main-section text. No general METHOD_USE/FOCUS/core expansion. Prior/citation/denial/future/conditional/bibliography and product-context guards remain. New-route numbered-reference prefix blocked, unaccepted workflow evidence retained; original sentence and offsets preserved.
annotation_policy.journal_soc_disambiguation: Only bare SOC/Soc in a bounded adjacent journal abbreviation+publication year sequence is retained as non-scientific mention. No case-only ban; full spin-orbit coupling and separate true SOC evidence remain independent. Evidence adds acronym_disambiguation original context/span/hit offsets; validator recomputes it. No global bibliography/FOCUS/METHOD_USE/core/taxonomy/input change.
annotation_policy.host_device_role: L1 host(s) for controlled-adjective OLED/PhOLED/organic light-emitting diode alias only; no bare host. New named alias has local nonmaterial/history/denial/hypothesis/comparison guard and exact recomputable host_device_role evidence. Legacy aliases,all L2,core ranking/input/gold unchanged. v13 retains44 semantic IDs;no evaluation map change.
annotation_policy.emitting_dipole_orientation: Existing L2 question alias, forward emitting/emission [transition] dipole orientation and reverse orientation of emitting/emission [transition] dipoles;no bare electric/magnetic dipole. New alias alone reuses existing local measurement-denial helper and exact recomputable orientation_alias trace. Core/source/method policy and legacy patterns unchanged;metadata centrality never supplies missing body evidence.
annotation_policy.metadata_domain_qualifiers: Optional controlled metadata_context_patterns for level1 domain-specific topics must match frozen title/abstract;body cannot supply the domain. Current OLED optical-outcoupling topic requires OLED/organic/polymer LED context. No existing IDs or evidence windows change.
annotation_policy.running_headers: Two or more distinct PDF pages must contain the same normalized 32–200-character line in first two nonblank lines of frozen fulltext chunks with integer page_start=0. Only pagination digits/typography normalized;explicit current scientific statements exempt. Header hits supply mentions only;exact text/positions/hit offsets and all occurrences validated. No page-start guessing, no hidden PDF reads, no ID/title exception. Immutable old predictions retained.
